data.scope: Only specifically requested, independently checked execution families; no fabricated global census of all tool commands.

families.invalid_or_incomplete_attempts: Wrong initial path caused LoadError before reference load; missing ProbePlayer.x stopped second attempt at Fishing:49. Both retained. Expected caught vector exceptions are not failed processes.
families.time_capture: Fishing attempts UTC unavailable; Owner and Phone actual UTC/argv/stdout/stderr/exit captured.
families.boundary: Selected actual coordinator/definitions/conversion callback. Input, messages, animation, map/player and registration providers are explicit surrogates; no whole conversion chain, game, host or real save.

families.metadata_limit: tee pipeline exit0 is not independently captured Ruby exit. Actual UTC and exact patch were not captured; administrative update UTC is not run time. Outputs labelled TOOL_VALIDATION still execute original callbacks/definitions.
families.boundary: Loaded original inspected definitions and target callback, bare object/collector. No normal migration chain, old save, creature creation or bag UI. O independent Owner run does not retroactively supply K missing metadata.

Actual two switch handlers directly invoked using SparseArray/rng/debug surrogates. Nine NoMethodError diagnostics are caught by logonerr, not nine failed processes. No full battle initialization, action registration, frequency distribution, UI reporter or host.
families.time_capture: Actual UTC absent from completed command item; adjacent Ruby version check is language/runtime inventory, not an extra reference probe.

families.repeat_output_limit: Earlier entry counter exit0 is recorded; its redirected result was overwritten by the later labels-only BULBASAUR/EEVEE rerun. Do not describe 13 independent retained vectors. Current final output has three entry cases.
families.invalid_fixture_attempt: First facility script selected Summary with numeric menu stub1 instead of Entry0, then lacked pbSummary. Corrected command selects actual Entry label; original exit1 retained. Not a source failure finding.
families.language_only_control: Two loop-local iterations (0 then nil) in entry probe are a separate Ruby language control, not two more reference vectors.
families.boundary: Original inspected Challenge/Rulesets/selected full entry method and recorded field/record/restore/setters. Game.save only increments a memory request counter; recorded Marshal packet is harness-created. Base Battle initializer/start and maps/scenes remain stubs. No real save, whole battle or native Summary.
families.time_capture: Actual UTC absent from selected CLI completed records.

families.invalid_fixture_attempts: Purifyv1 exit1 and v2 caught NameError/exit0 both lacked inherited Sprite.angle. v3 restores reader default0 and original first refresh completes; suspected source error refuted. v1 ordinary explicit angle case alone does not validate invalid first-refresh fixture.
families.controlled_interruption_scope: Capture MessageInterruption and bag message failure are harness-injected exceptions; they establish reached reference prefixes with those surrogates, not physical user cancel/host failure/recovery.
families.boundary: Actual selected Purify view/flow, capture storage/peer and Bag/PC toss coordinators. Drawing, Sprite, bitmap, messages, species/items, storage/container and scene providers are memory surrogates. No capture battle, native UI, input, pixel result or real save.
families.time_capture: Bag exact UTC/argv/Rubyexit/runtime captured. Purify/Capture actual UTC absent from completed CLI items.

families.assertion_overlap: 169 is only a sum of assertions, including overlapping catalog cases; not 169 independent battle vectors.
families.language_probe: Generic temporary namespace and empty Array under Ruby2.6.10; existing/absent binding and lack of public instance constructor. No actual reference class, metadata/compiler, game model or host loaded.
families.boundary: Python Fraction fixed math and lexical/catalog artifact parsing only; no reference file evaluation/import/instantiation. No independent full gameplay or combat model.

Standard-library RIFF/SF2/PCM/table reader and PE/CLI/COFF/resource/string/CIL byte decoders. read_bytes/struct/decoded instructions are data access, not EXE/DLL/IL/Ruby loading or execution. No synthesizer, actual audio, GPU, WindowsAPI/CLR behavior or native compatibility selector.
families.native_limits: Exact remaining .text/CFG/dataflow/version-selection/host API and unselected string limits preserved from current R6-B/limits.json; successful parser commands do not close them.

data.summation_warning: Process exit0 includes invalid Purifyv2, repeated F entry execution and expected caught exceptions. Case counts stay per family; shared Owner cases and repeat runs are not unique global vectors.
